# Generated curriculum snapshot

**DO NOT EDIT files in this directory by hand.**

This directory is the versioned runtime profile consumed before
`@infraenv/curriculum` is published. Replace it from the sibling source of
truth with:

```bash
npm run content:sync
```

The sync task reads
`../infraenv-curriculum/dist/profiles/runtime/catalog.json`, writes a canonical
snapshot here, and records its SHA-256 checksum. Curriculum prose and scenario
assets are CC BY 4.0; schemas, generated contracts and runtime code are
Apache-2.0.
